meta.note: Full cross-ISO × pathway × endpoint table. 175 rows (7 ISO × 5 pathway × 5 endpoint). Pathways: 1 (VRE + storage + offshore headline), 1a (strict onshore Card R baseline), 2a (behavioral pivot), 2b (economic pivot), 3 (proactive clean firm per §24.8 NOAK-2035). Endpoints are the 5 headline thresholds out of the full 10-endpoint sweep.
meta.reliability_tax_formula: SPEC §24.4 locked 5-component formula: (annualized_new_gas_capex + new_gas_FOM + existing_gas_FOM_carried + priced_VRE_curtailment + annualized_VRE_storage_overbuild_capex) ÷ cumulative_demand_MWh_2025_2050. Gross; no capacity-market netting (Card M').
meta.gas_sizing_basis: active_new_gas_fleet_mw is worst-hour sized per SPEC §24.5 (99.97th percentile of margin-inclusive residual gap). NOT ELCC.
meta.stranding_basis: stranded_new_gas_* columns are ABSOLUTE per Card K' — Σ initial_cap_mw / stranded_capex_usd for new-gas vintages where stranded_flag=True (CF<15% for 2 consecutive years, SPEC Card F').
dropped_columns_vs_v1: ccs_ccgt synthetic stranding proxy (replaced by Card K' ledger)
